review:
Rise of Pyramids gives Egyptian myth a sci-fi makeover on an octagonal cluster grid. Gods in shimmering armour are the symbols, and winning clusters tumble. Wilds can blow up all adjacent symbols when they trigger a tumble, even ones not in the win.

Money symbols from 0.5x to 1,000x can land, and four or more activate a respin feature with three respins, where only money symbols and blanks land. Pragmatic Play advertises up to 10,000x. Note the RTP is 95.97%. The octagonal grid is unusual and gives the game a distinctive look.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
